title: USS Truman to the Rescue
description: USS Harry S Truman prepares for her first relief effort mission assisting the survivors of Hurricane Katrina. Scenes include Sailors preparing the ship, forklifts on runway, helicopters loading, landing and taking off from the aircraft carrier.  Soundbites from a couple unidentified crewmembers.  Video from Joint Task Force Katrina. hkat
keywords: Hurricane Katrina, test, USS Harry S. Truman
